title: Jumpstart Your Job Search - Teal Webinar - October 23rd
description:
Are you job searching and need to write your resume? Check out Teal's Jumpstart Your Job Search webinar this week about ATS-Friendly resumes and more!

This week's live webinar was hosted by Recruiter and Social Media Manager, Leah Dillon and Community and Support Specialist, Emily Woodward. They'll share how to get started with Teal and use the Resume Builder.

Whether it's building your resume, searching for the right job, or marketing yourself for the role you want, we've got you covered with tools like our FREE Chrome Extension, Job Tracker, and Resume Builder. Head over to www.tealhq.com to get started on your AI-powered resume.

These webinars will share similar information and tips every week, so if you're unable to join live, watch past episodes here on YouTube!
